Usage: yantra prefs [options] [action] [key] [value]

Manage personalization preferences (machine layer + merged view)

Arguments:
  action          get | set | list | approve
  key             dotted preference key (e.g. defaults.detail)
  value           value (for set)

Options:
  --json          emit JSON (default: false)
  --debug         verbose logging on stderr (default: false)
  --forget <key>  delete a preference value (privacy control)
  -h, --help      display help for command
